Hello Patients and welcome to the channel! Dr. Adam here - Owner of the Halton Chiropractic Clinic

250 Wyecroft Road Unit 5, Oakville ON | L6K 3T7

Things you'll find on our channel: Real Patient Stories, Thorough Anatomical Explanations with Graphics, Case Walkthroughs, and an open & honest, no-BS approach to resolving everyday aches & pains. 

Oh, and terrible jokes made strictly for the purposes of my own laughter. Any enjoyment on your end is purely coincidental but definitely celebrated :)

Legal Disclaimer: Any and all advice that could be perceived as "medical/health" related on this channel should not be applied without first consulting with your healthcare practitioner and receiving a full history/physical examination.
